description: Stele gives AI agents a shared, persistent knowledge graph and task system for your projects. Capture decisions, architecture, lessons, and work once, then make that context available across ChatGPT, Codex, Claude, Cursor, and other MCP-compatible agents. Agents can find prior context, maintain project knowledge, and coordinate work without starting from scratch.
